text:
The two blocks are fixed by the immediate-successor clues: Cara–Hana, and Ivo–Finn–Gus, with the Cara block entirely before the Ivo block. Dev must occupy a slot before Cara, and Ann must sit exactly two slots from Cara.

The only placement that leaves legal slots for Ben and Elif under the separation constraints is Cara in 2 (so Hana in 3 and Ann in 4), Dev in 1, Ivo–Finn–Gus in 6–8, Ben in 5, and Elif in 9. Every other block placement contradicts at least one of the “before” or “at least three apart” clues.
